geometries.method: Editorial waypoints in the source-described Ligurian, Provençal, and Catalan sectors; not measured current-core positions or a whole-current path. The approximate OSW NECS shape overlaps the mapped Mediterranean coastal strip, so that Atlantic state is excluded semantically.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The named flow is described from the Ligurian Sea along the Provençal and Catalan coasts. The cited paper reports widths and local sections, not a comparable whole-current alongstream length.

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: The source locates the study off Toulon in the northwestern Mediterranean and describes the repeated glider transects at 6.20°E. It does not provide a reusable digitized current footprint in this ledger.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The approximate OSW NECS polygon overlaps parts of the mapped Mediterranean coastal strip. The MEDI assignment follows the source's named sea, not a sampled footprint/polygon intersection.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: Glider measurements ran 2–19 December 2011; HF radar fields ran 6–19 December 2011. This row records the combined study window, not continuous coverage by both instruments.

relations.interpretation: OSW classification of a source-described regional segment; no path or length equivalence is inferred
